Connectors

J2 and J3 carry the two cylinder banks; J1 collects sensors and buses; J4 brings in battery power and drives the pumps.

Sensors and communication.

Show pinout

Show pinout

J4

Power, communication and pumps.

Show pinout

Power and ground

Battery supply is split into separate KL30 groups; each group uses two pins. Connect all ground pins.

SignalPurposePins
KL30 GDIBattery +12 V, GDI injector stageJ4: 26, 27
KL30 COILBattery +12 V, ignition coil stageJ4: 28, 29
KL30 PUMPBattery +12 V, fuel pump and starter outputsJ4: 32, 33
KL30 A/BBattery +12 V, supply outputs A/BJ4: 34, 35
KL15Ignition switch inputJ4: 18
GNDGroundJ1: 5, 10, 30; J2: 13, 14; J3: 22, 23; J4: 14, 15, 19, 20, 21

Software

Setup, live data and logs work over Ethernet in the BrainBus GDI-8 application. It will be published on the Downloads page together with the product release.

Pinout and specifications are preliminary and may change before release. Questions: info@ailuohai-tech.com.
